DESCRIPTION: Spindle noise and oversize holes on drill cell DC-3
LONGDESCRIPTION: Operator reported grinding noise from the spindle; hole gauge showed 3 holes over tolerance on frame 38. Spindle runout 0.04 mm. Front bearing found pitted and replaced; cell re-qualified on test coupon.

DESCRIPTION: Quarterly PM drill cell DC-3
LONGDESCRIPTION: Lubricated spindle; checked runout 0.01 mm; replaced coolant filter; verified drill feed calibration.

DESCRIPTION: Spindle vibration alarm on drill cell DC-3
LONGDESCRIPTION: Vibration alarm at 2.1 mm/s RMS after 18k holes since last bearing change. Front bearing showed early wear and was replaced. Coolant ingress found at the spindle seal; seal replaced.

DESCRIPTION: Quarterly PM drill cell DC-3
LONGDESCRIPTION: Lubricated spindle; runout 0.02 mm; noted slight weep at spindle seal; replaced coolant filter.

DESCRIPTION: Quarterly PM drill cell DC-3
LONGDESCRIPTION: Lubricated spindle; runout 0.02 mm; spindle seal checked dry.

DESCRIPTION: Oversize holes and spindle runout on drill cell DC-3
LONGDESCRIPTION: Hole-quality audit found 4 oversize holes on frame 40. Runout 0.035 mm. Front bearing replaced (third replacement in 12 months). Seal intact; coolant concentration found above spec.

DESCRIPTION: Engineering review of repeat spindle bearing failures DC-3
LONGDESCRIPTION: Reliability engineer reviewing three front bearing replacements in 12 months on DC-3. Candidate causes: coolant ingress past spindle seal and coolant concentration drift. Recommend vibration trending and seal inspection at every PM.

DESCRIPTION: Quarterly PM drill cell DC-3
LONGDESCRIPTION: Lubricated spindle; runout 0.02 mm; added seal inspection and coolant concentration check to the PM.

DESCRIPTION: Clamp pressure fault on drill cell DC-4
LONGDESCRIPTION: Pressure-foot clamp dropped below setpoint intermittently. Regulator diaphragm torn; regulator replaced.

DESCRIPTION: Quarterly PM drill cell DC-4
LONGDESCRIPTION: Lubricated spindle; runout 0.01 mm; replaced coolant filter.

DESCRIPTION: Sealant bead skips on robot RS-2
LONGDESCRIPTION: Sealant bead had gaps on 2 of 30 fasteners. Nozzle partially blocked by cured sealant; nozzle replaced and purge interval shortened.

DESCRIPTION: Sealant bead skips on robot RS-2
LONGDESCRIPTION: Repeat of bead gaps. Mixer cartridge past pot life on night shift; cartridge changed and shift handover check added.

LONGDESCRIPTION: TC-7 trailed the profile by 7 °C during ramp. Lead insulation damaged at the connector panel again. Lead replaced and re-routed; edge guard requested.

LONGDESCRIPTION: Fit grommet edge guard to the thermocouple connector panel to stop lead chafing. Guard not fitted: part on backorder.
